svg.title: Novu Box: one pull request, from label to delete
svg.desc: Swimlane across Developer, GitHub, Cloudflare and the box container: the box label makes ci.ts check the labeler's write access, have the hub register the box, start the box from base's snapshot, apply the PR head, run doctor and edit one sticky PR comment; each push cancels the older run and re-applies; removing the label or closing the PR deletes the box.
